SELECT a.sample_id,
    a.source_record_id,
    a.analysis_run_id,
    a.repeat_number,
    a.analyzed_on,
    a.group_name,
    f.source_label,
    f.unit_label,
    r.source_dtype,
    r.value_float,

    r.source_field_id,
    s.indicator_id,
    i.code AS indicator_code,
    i.name AS indicator_name,
    s.unit_id,

    s.method_id,
    m.name AS method_name,
    s.reviewed AS mapping_reviewed,
    i.reviewed AS indicator_reviewed,
    u.reviewed AS unit_reviewed,
    m.reviewed AS method_reviewed
   FROM geochem.analysis_run a
     JOIN geochem.analysis_result r USING (analysis_run_id, group_name)
     JOIN geochem.source_field f USING (source_field_id, group_name, source_dtype)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.source_field_semantics s USING (source_field_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.indicator i USING (indicator_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.measurement_unit u USING (unit_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.analysis_method m USING (method_id);

SELECT m.wellbore_id,
    b.name AS wellbore_name,
    t.well_id,
    w.well_name,
    w.area,
    t.import_batch_id,
    f.group_name,
    t.source_field_id,
    f.source_label,
    f.source_dtype,
    f.unit_label,
    z.indicator_id,
    i.name AS indicator_name,
    z.method_id,
    d.name AS method_name,
    z.unit_id,
    u.symbol AS unit_symbol,
    'MD'::text AS depth_type,
    'm'::text AS depth_unit,
    t.md_datum AS depth_datum,
    t.result_count,
    t.numeric_result_count,
    t.sample_count,
    t.run_count,
    t.min_top_md,
    t.max_base_md
   FROM ( SELECT s.well_id,
            s.md_datum,
            sr.import_batch_id,
            r.source_field_id,
            count(*) AS result_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.value_float IS NOT NULL OR r.value_int IS NOT NULL) AS numeric_result_count,
            count(DISTINCT a.sample_id) AS sample_count,
            count(DISTINCT a.analysis_run_id) AS run_count,
            min(s.top_md) FILTER (WHERE s.top_md >= 0::double precision AND s.base_md >= s.top_md AND (s.top_md <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision])) AND (s.base_md <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision]))) AS min_top_md,
            max(s.base_md) FILTER (WHERE s.top_md >= 0::double precision AND s.base_md >= s.top_md AND (s.top_md <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision])) AND (s.base_md <> ALL (ARRAY['NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision]))) AS max_base_md
           FROM geochem.analysis_result r
             JOIN geochem.analysis_run a USING (analysis_run_id)
             JOIN geochem.sample s USING (sample_id)
             JOIN geochem.source_record sr ON sr.source_record_id = a.source_record_id
          GROUP BY s.well_id, s.md_datum, sr.import_batch_id, r.source_field_id) t
     JOIN geochem.source_field f USING (source_field_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well w ON w.well_id = t.well_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well_wellbore_link m ON m.well_id = t.well_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.wellbore b USING (wellbore_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.source_field_semantics z USING (source_field_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.indicator i USING (indicator_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.analysis_method d USING (method_id)
     LEFT JOIN geochem.measurement_unit u USING (unit_id);

        CASE
            WHEN r.value_int IS NOT NULL THEN r.value_int::numeric

   FROM geochem.sample s
     JOIN geochem.analysis_run a USING (sample_id)

     JOIN geochem.source_field f USING (source_field_id, group_name, source_dtype)
     JOIN geochem.source_record sr ON sr.source_record_id = a.source_record_id
     JOIN geochem.import_batch b ON b.import_batch_id = sr.import_batch_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well w ON w.well_id = s.well_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well_wellbore_link l ON l.well_id = s.well_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.wellbore wb ON wb.wellbore_id = l.wellbore_id

SELECT import_batch_id,
    group_name,
    source_field_id,
    source_label,
    unit_label,
    count(*) AS result_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_quality_metadata) AS annotated_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'unreviewed'::text) AS unreviewed_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'accepted'::text) AS accepted_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'suspect'::text) AS suspect_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'rejected'::text) AS rejected_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE qualifier = ANY (ARRAY['below_detection'::text, 'below_quantification'::text, 'less_than'::text, 'greater_than'::text])) AS censored_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE absolute_uncertainty IS NOT NULL) AS uncertainty_count
   FROM geochem.v_geochemical_measurement_qc
  GROUP BY import_batch_id, group_name, source_field_id, source_label, unit_label;

SELECT a.analysis_run_id,
    a.sample_id,
    s.name AS sample_name,
    a.source_record_id,
    sr.import_batch_id,
    sr.row_number,
    a.group_name,
    a.repeat_number,
    a.analyzed_on,
    s.well_id,
    s.wellbore_id,
    s.wellbore_name,
    w.well_name,
    w.area,
    s.top_md,
    s.base_md,
    s.depth_type,
    s.depth_unit,
    s.depth_datum,
    COALESCE(x.result_count, 0::bigint) AS result_count,
    COALESCE(x.values_by_field, '{}'::jsonb) AS values_by_field
   FROM geochem.analysis_run a
     JOIN geochem.v_sample_wellbore s USING (sample_id)
     JOIN geochem.source_record sr ON sr.source_record_id = a.source_record_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well w ON w.well_id = s.well_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS result_count,
            jsonb_object_agg(r.source_field_id::text, COALESCE(to_jsonb(r.value_float), to_jsonb(r.value_int), to_jsonb(r.value_text))) AS values_by_field
           FROM geochem.analysis_result r
          WHERE r.analysis_run_id = a.analysis_run_id) x ON true;

SELECT a.interpretation_id,
    a.interpretation_interval_id AS interval_a_id,
    b.interpretation_interval_id AS interval_b_id,
    a.unit_level,
    a.unit_name AS unit_a,
    b.unit_name AS unit_b,
    GREATEST(a.top_depth_m, b.top_depth_m) AS overlap_top_m,
    LEAST(a.bottom_depth_m, b.bottom_depth_m) AS overlap_bottom_m
   FROM geochem.lithostrat_interpretation_interval a
     JOIN geochem.lithostrat_interpretation_interval b ON a.interpretation_id = b.interpretation_id AND a.interpretation_interval_id < b.interpretation_interval_id AND a.unit_level = b.unit_level AND NOT a.depth_type IS DISTINCT FROM b.depth_type AND NOT a.depth_datum IS DISTINCT FROM b.depth_datum AND a.top_depth_m < b.bottom_depth_m AND b.top_depth_m < a.bottom_depth_m;

SELECT a.analysis_run_id,
    a.sample_id,
    s.name AS sample_name,
    a.source_record_id,
    sr.import_batch_id,
    sr.row_number,
    a.group_name,
    a.repeat_number,
    s.well_id,
    s.wellbore_id,
    s.wellbore_name,
    w.well_name,
    w.area,
    s.top_md,
    s.base_md,
    s.depth_type,
    s.depth_unit,
    s.depth_datum,
    x.toc_wt_pct,
    x.s1_mg_g,
    x.s2_mg_g,
    x.s3_mg_g,
    x.tmax_c,
    x.hi_mg_g,
    x.oi_mg_g
   FROM geochem.analysis_run a
     JOIN geochem.v_sample_wellbore s USING (sample_id)
     JOIN geochem.source_record sr ON sr.source_record_id = a.source_record_id
     LEFT JOIN geochem.well w ON w.well_id = s.well_id
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source_field.group_name,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'TOC [%wt]'::text) AS toc_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'S1 [ppt (mg/g)]'::text) AS s1_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'S2 [ppt (mg/g)]'::text) AS s2_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'S3 [ppt (mg/g)]'::text) AS s3_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'T-max [°C]'::text) AS tmax_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'HI [ppt (mg/g) (a/b)]'::text) AS hi_id,
            max(source_field.source_field_id) FILTER (WHERE source_field.source_label = 'OI [ppt (mg/g) (a/b)]'::text) AS oi_id
           FROM geochem.source_field
          WHERE source_field.group_name ~~ 'Pyrol%'::text
          GROUP BY source_field.group_name) k ON k.group_name = a.group_name
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.toc_id) AS toc_wt_pct,
            max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.s1_id) AS s1_mg_g,
            max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.s2_id) AS s2_mg_g,
            max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.s3_id) AS s3_mg_g,
            max(r.value_int) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.tmax_id) AS tmax_c,
            max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.hi_id) AS hi_mg_g,
            max(r.value_float) FILTER (WHERE r.source_field_id = k.oi_id) AS oi_mg_g
           FROM geochem.analysis_result r
          WHERE r.analysis_run_id = a.analysis_run_id AND (r.source_field_id = ANY (ARRAY[k.toc_id, k.s1_id, k.s2_id, k.s3_id, k.tmax_id, k.hi_id, k.oi_id]))) x ON true
  WHERE a.group_name ~~ 'Pyrol%'::text;

   FROM geochem.v_sample_wellbore s
     LEFT JOIN geochem.wellbore_interpretation_selection p USING (wellbore_id);

SELECT s.sample_id,
    s.well_id,
    s.wellbore_id,
    s.wellbore_name,
    s.selected_interpretation_id AS interpretation_id,
    i.interpretation_interval_id,
    i.unit_name,
    i.unit_level,
    s.top_md AS sample_top_md,
    s.base_md AS sample_base_md,
    i.top_depth_m AS interval_top_md,
    i.bottom_depth_m AS interval_bottom_md,
    s.depth_type,
    s.depth_datum,
        CASE
            WHEN s.top_md::numeric >= i.top_depth_m AND s.base_md::numeric <= i.bottom_depth_m THEN 'contained'::text
            ELSE 'partial'::text
        END AS match_kind,
        CASE
            WHEN s.top_md = s.base_md THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE (LEAST(s.base_md::numeric, i.bottom_depth_m) - GREATEST(s.top_md::numeric, i.top_depth_m)) / (s.base_md::numeric - s.top_md::numeric)
        END AS overlap_fraction,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sample_id, i.unit_level) AS matches_at_level
   FROM geochem.v_sample_lithostrat_context s
     JOIN geochem.lithostrat_interpretation_interval i ON i.interpretation_id = s.selected_interpretation_id AND i.depth_type = s.depth_type AND i.depth_datum = s.depth_datum
  WHERE s.wellbore_link_reviewed AND s.sample_depth_valid AND NULLIF(btrim(s.depth_datum), ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND (s.top_md = s.base_md AND s.top_md::numeric >= i.top_depth_m AND s.top_md::numeric < i.bottom_depth_m OR s.top_md < s.base_md AND s.top_md::numeric < i.bottom_depth_m AND s.base_md::numeric > i.top_depth_m);

SELECT s.sample_id,
    s.name AS sample_name,
    s.well_id,
    s.wellbore_id,
    s.wellbore_name,
    s.selected_interpretation_id,
    s.top_md,
    s.base_md,
    s.depth_type,
    s.depth_datum,
    COALESCE(m.match_count, 0::bigint) AS match_count,
    COALESCE(m.ambiguous, false) AS ambiguous,
        CASE
            WHEN s.wellbore_id IS NULL THEN 'no_wellbore'::text
            WHEN s.selected_interpretation_id IS NULL THEN 'no_selected_version'::text
            WHEN s.wellbore_link_reviewed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN 'unreviewed_wellbore_link'::text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.check_numeric_result_quality()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM geochem.analysis_result
               WHERE analysis_run_id=NEW.analysis_run_id AND source_field_id=NEW.source_field_id
                 AND source_dtype='string')
       AND (NEW.qualifier<>'unreported' OR NEW.reporting_bound IS NOT NULL OR NEW.detection_limit IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.quantification_limit IS NOT NULL OR NEW.absolute_uncertainty IS NOT NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Numeric qualifiers, limits and uncertainty require a numeric result'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.refresh_analysis_catalogs()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO geochem.measurement_unit(code,symbol,description)
    SELECT DISTINCT 'source:' || unit_label, unit_label, 'Exact source unit; conversion not verified'
    FROM geochem.source_field
    WHERE target_table='analysis_result' AND nullif(btrim(unit_label),'') IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.analysis_method(code,name,description)
    SELECT 'source-group:' || group_name, group_name,
           'Provisional source group; analytical method requires review'
    FROM geochem.data_group WHERE scope='analysis'
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.indicator(code,name,description)
    SELECT 'source-field:' || source_field_id, source_label,
           'Provisional source field in group ' || group_name
    FROM geochem.source_field WHERE target_table='analysis_result'
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.source_field_semantics(source_field_id,indicator_id,unit_id,method_id,note)
    SELECT f.source_field_id,i.indicator_id,u.unit_id,m.method_id,
           'Automatically seeded; equivalence across source fields has not been established'
    FROM geochem.source_field f
    JOIN geochem.indicator i ON i.code='source-field:' || f.source_field_id
    LEFT JOIN geochem.measurement_unit u ON u.code='source:' || f.unit_label
    LEFT JOIN geochem.analysis_method m ON m.code='source-group:' || f.group_name
    WHERE f.target_table='analysis_result'
    ON CONFLICT (source_field_id) DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.refresh_wellbore_catalog()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO geochem.wellbore(code,name,note)
    SELECT 'well:' || well_id,well_name,'Source well identity; not automatically merged by name'
    FROM geochem.well ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.well_wellbore_link(well_id,wellbore_id)
    SELECT w.well_id,b.wellbore_id FROM geochem.well w
    JOIN geochem.wellbore b ON b.code='well:' || w.well_id
    ON CONFLICT(well_id) DO NOTHING;

    -- Explicit source relation takes priority. Name matching requires exactly one well.
    INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link(lithostrat_wellbore_id,wellbore_id,match_basis)
    SELECT l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,m.wellbore_id,
           CASE WHEN l.well_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'existing_link' ELSE 'unique_exact_name' END
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    JOIN geochem.well_wellbore_link m ON m.well_id=coalesce(l.well_id,
        (SELECT min(w.well_id) FROM geochem.well w
         WHERE w.well_name=l.wellbore_name HAVING count(*)=1))
    ON CONFLICT(lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO geochem.wellbore(code,name,note)
    SELECT 'lithostrat:' || l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,l.wellbore_name,
           'No unambiguous geochemical well match'
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    LEFT JOIN geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link m USING(lithostrat_wellbore_id)
    WHERE m.lithostrat_wellbore_id IS NULL ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link(lithostrat_wellbore_id,wellbore_id,match_basis)
    SELECT l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,b.wellbore_id,'separate'
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    JOIN geochem.wellbore b ON b.code='lithostrat:' || l.lithostrat_wellbore_id
    ON CONFLICT(lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.snapshot_lithostrat_sources()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE v record; new_id bigint;
BEGIN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('geochem:lithostrat-snapshot',0));
    FOR v IN SELECT DISTINCT i.import_batch_id,i.lithostrat_wellbore_id,m.wellbore_id
        FROM geochem.wellbore_lithostrat_interval i
        JOIN geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link m USING(lithostrat_wellbore_id)
    LOOP
        INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_interpretation(wellbore_id,version_tag,author,description,
            source_import_batch_id,source_lithostrat_wellbore_id)
        VALUES(v.wellbore_id,'source:' || v.import_batch_id || ':' || v.lithostrat_wellbore_id,
            'source import','Unmodified source snapshot; conflicts retained, depth system unknown',
            v.import_batch_id,v.lithostrat_wellbore_id)
        ON CONFLICT(source_import_batch_id,source_lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING
        RETURNING interpretation_id INTO new_id;
        IF new_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_interpretation_interval(interpretation_id,interval_number,
                lithostrat_unit_id,unit_name,unit_level,top_depth_m,bottom_depth_m,depth_reference,source_interval_id)
            SELECT new_id,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY i.source_sheet,i.source_row)::integer,
                i.lithostrat_unit_id,u.unit_name,u.unit_level,i.top_depth_m,i.bottom_depth_m,
                i.depth_reference,i.wellbore_lithostrat_interval_id
            FROM geochem.wellbore_lithostrat_interval i JOIN geochem.lithostrat_unit u USING(lithostrat_unit_id)
            WHERE i.import_batch_id=v.import_batch_id AND i.lithostrat_wellbore_id=v.lithostrat_wellbore_id;
            UPDATE geochem.lithostrat_interpretation SET status='published',published_at=current_timestamp
            WHERE interpretation_id=new_id;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.check_numeric_result_quality()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM geochem.analysis_result
               WHERE analysis_run_id=NEW.analysis_run_id AND source_field_id=NEW.source_field_id
                 AND source_dtype='string')
       AND (NEW.qualifier<>'unreported' OR NEW.reporting_bound IS NOT NULL OR NEW.detection_limit IS NOT NULL
            OR NEW.quantification_limit IS NOT NULL OR NEW.absolute_uncertainty IS NOT NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Numeric qualifiers, limits and uncertainty require a numeric result'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.refresh_analysis_catalogs()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO geochem.measurement_unit(code,symbol,description)
    SELECT DISTINCT 'source:' || unit_label, unit_label, 'Exact source unit; conversion not verified'
    FROM geochem.source_field
    WHERE target_table='analysis_result' AND nullif(btrim(unit_label),'') IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.analysis_method(code,name,description)
    SELECT 'source-group:' || group_name, group_name,
           'Provisional source group; analytical method requires review'
    FROM geochem.data_group WHERE scope='analysis'
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.indicator(code,name,description)
    SELECT 'source-field:' || source_field_id, source_label,
           'Provisional source field in group ' || group_name
    FROM geochem.source_field WHERE target_table='analysis_result'
    ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.source_field_semantics(source_field_id,indicator_id,unit_id,method_id,note)
    SELECT f.source_field_id,i.indicator_id,u.unit_id,m.method_id,
           'Automatically seeded; equivalence across source fields has not been established'
    FROM geochem.source_field f
    JOIN geochem.indicator i ON i.code='source-field:' || f.source_field_id
    LEFT JOIN geochem.measurement_unit u ON u.code='source:' || f.unit_label
    LEFT JOIN geochem.analysis_method m ON m.code='source-group:' || f.group_name
    WHERE f.target_table='analysis_result'
    ON CONFLICT (source_field_id) DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.refresh_wellbore_catalog()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO geochem.wellbore(code,name,note)
    SELECT 'well:' || well_id,well_name,'Source well identity; not automatically merged by name'
    FROM geochem.well ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.well_wellbore_link(well_id,wellbore_id)
    SELECT w.well_id,b.wellbore_id FROM geochem.well w
    JOIN geochem.wellbore b ON b.code='well:' || w.well_id
    ON CONFLICT(well_id) DO NOTHING;

    -- Explicit source relation takes priority. Name matching requires exactly one well.
    INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link(lithostrat_wellbore_id,wellbore_id,match_basis)
    SELECT l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,m.wellbore_id,
           CASE WHEN l.well_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'existing_link' ELSE 'unique_exact_name' END
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    JOIN geochem.well_wellbore_link m ON m.well_id=coalesce(l.well_id,
        (SELECT min(w.well_id) FROM geochem.well w
         WHERE w.well_name=l.wellbore_name HAVING count(*)=1))
    ON CONFLICT(lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO geochem.wellbore(code,name,note)
    SELECT 'lithostrat:' || l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,l.wellbore_name,
           'No unambiguous geochemical well match'
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    LEFT JOIN geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link m USING(lithostrat_wellbore_id)
    WHERE m.lithostrat_wellbore_id IS NULL ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;
    INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link(lithostrat_wellbore_id,wellbore_id,match_basis)
    SELECT l.lithostrat_wellbore_id,b.wellbore_id,'separate'
    FROM geochem.lithostrat_wellbore l
    JOIN geochem.wellbore b ON b.code='lithostrat:' || l.lithostrat_wellbore_id
    ON CONFLICT(lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION geochem.snapshot_lithostrat_sources()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE v record; new_id bigint;
BEGIN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('geochem:lithostrat-snapshot',0));
    FOR v IN SELECT DISTINCT i.import_batch_id,i.lithostrat_wellbore_id,m.wellbore_id
        FROM geochem.wellbore_lithostrat_interval i
        JOIN geochem.lithostrat_wellbore_link m USING(lithostrat_wellbore_id)
    LOOP
        INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_interpretation(wellbore_id,version_tag,author,description,
            source_import_batch_id,source_lithostrat_wellbore_id)
        VALUES(v.wellbore_id,'source:' || v.import_batch_id || ':' || v.lithostrat_wellbore_id,
            'source import','Unmodified source snapshot; conflicts retained, depth system unknown',
            v.import_batch_id,v.lithostrat_wellbore_id)
        ON CONFLICT(source_import_batch_id,source_lithostrat_wellbore_id) DO NOTHING
        RETURNING interpretation_id INTO new_id;
        IF new_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO geochem.lithostrat_interpretation_interval(interpretation_id,interval_number,
                lithostrat_unit_id,unit_name,unit_level,top_depth_m,bottom_depth_m,depth_reference,source_interval_id)
            SELECT new_id,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY i.source_sheet,i.source_row)::integer,
                i.lithostrat_unit_id,u.unit_name,u.unit_level,i.top_depth_m,i.bottom_depth_m,
                i.depth_reference,i.wellbore_lithostrat_interval_id
            FROM geochem.wellbore_lithostrat_interval i JOIN geochem.lithostrat_unit u USING(lithostrat_unit_id)
            WHERE i.import_batch_id=v.import_batch_id AND i.lithostrat_wellbore_id=v.lithostrat_wellbore_id;
            UPDATE geochem.lithostrat_interpretation SET status='published',published_at=current_timestamp
            WHERE interpretation_id=new_id;
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END $function$
